title: Scammers are abusing an internal Microsoft account to send spam links
summary: Security researchers discovered that scammers are exploiting an internal Microsoft account to send spam emails containing malicious links, bypassing traditional email filters by leveraging the trusted Microsoft domain infrastructure.
problem_solved: Reports on a new email spoofing technique where attackers abuse legitimate Microsoft infrastructure to distribute spam and phishing campaigns under the guise of trusted Microsoft communications.
why_valuable: Raises awareness about advanced email-based attacks that exploit trusted cloud service providers' own infrastructure, helping organizations better understand emerging threats in their email security posture.
